workflow_runs.name: LinkScribe tests
workflow_runs.display_title: LinkScribe: reliable local workflows and v1.0 validation

head_commit.message:
Integrate fixed-text speaker timing and repair summary prompt examples

Keep baseline recognition text authoritative, run optional timing separately,
and release the recognizer before speaker inference. Add exact-source hosted
speaker QA with bounded resources and durable-result/export verification.

Remove answer-valued summary prompt examples without changing model defaults.
Repair maintained pytest discovery and source-archive completeness checks.
Retain failed experiments and scoped reviews. Local suite: 834 tests and 54
subtests passed; hosted verification and v1.0 quality gates remain pending.
